This is the THIRD local-mode result in this pass with an inverted causal sign via this same native node (after castle_doctrine_homicide's -0.1973 vs. published/cloud +), on top of prop99_cigarette_sales's separate omitted-comparison-group error — a pattern worth investigating as a systemic risk in how local-generated code constructs the treatment indicator before calling the native ATE function, not three unrelated coincidences. See notes.md.

estimate.note: GADS canonical from cloud reference run (drafted lane, TWFE DiD with state-clustered SEs): -0.0225 (a 2.25 percentage-point DECLINE in registration), p=0.0008 — matches the published direction (Kessler & Roth 2014: the active-choice nudge backfired) and is the first quantified GADS value for this benchmark (the source has no scalar gold). Backed by real robustness work the spec never asked for: an event-study confirming parallel pre-trends (max |pre-period coef| = 0.0063) and an in-space placebo test across 26 control states (only 4/26 placebos match or exceed the real effect's magnitude). The run's own report explicitly cites Kessler & Roth (2014) by name, correctly identifying its own external validation source.
